subject: A user's confession that stopped me cold last week
preview_text: I opened this message and just stared at my screen. It's about a mistake we all make without realizing.
body_paragraphs: A user named Sarah emailed me last week. She said something that made my heart drop. She wrote, 'I thought I was helping him by giving him extra treats. I didn't know I was slowly taking days off his life.'

That message haunts me. It's the quiet guilt so many of us carry. We show love with food, not knowing the cost. Sarah's dog, Buddy, was struggling to breathe after short walks. She felt helpless. That's the hidden truth—our good intentions can be the very thing hurting them.

This is exactly why the Progress Tracker with weight milestones isn't just a chart. It's your truth-teller. It turns that vague worry into clear, manageable steps. Sarah started using it religiously, and seeing the line trend down for Buddy was her relief. It replaced guilt with control.

Open the app right now and check your dog's Progress Tracker. Just look at the last data point. That's not just a number—it's proof you're doing right by them. P.S. Sarah sent a new photo yesterday. Buddy's running again. That's the whole point.
